about: Another player writes in a language the player doesn't read; the player asks what he wrote and to answer, Allay reads the chat (chat_history, a server tool), translates, and offers the reply in his language; the player clicks Reply.

question.en: what did he write? reply that I have no diamonds
question.ru: что он написал? ответь ему, что у меня нет алмазов
question.es: ¿qué escribió? respóndele que no tengo diamantes

line.en: ¿Alguien tiene diamantes? Cambio un libro de Reparación por 10.
line.ru: Anyone got diamonds? Trading a Mending book for 10.
line.es: Anyone got diamonds? Trading a Mending book for 10.

answer.en: Notch wrote in Spanish: “Anyone got diamonds? Trading a Mending book for 10.” You could reply in Spanish: &f“Lo siento, no tengo diamantes, ¡quizá mañana!”&r <button action="say" text="Lo siento, no tengo diamantes, ¡quizá mañana!">Reply</button>
answer.ru: Notch пишет: «У кого есть алмазы? Меняю книгу „Починка“ на 10». Ответить можно так: &f“Sorry, I'm out of diamonds, maybe tomorrow!”&r <button action="say" text="Sorry, I'm out of diamonds, maybe tomorrow!">Ответить</button>
answer.es: Notch escribió: «¿Alguien tiene diamantes? Cambio un libro de Reparación por 10». Puedes responder en inglés: &f“Sorry, I'm out of diamonds, maybe tomorrow!”&r <button action="say" text="Sorry, I'm out of diamonds, maybe tomorrow!">Responder</button>
